title: Nagy Imre újratemetése (1989. június 16.) (Reburial of Imre Nagy & Moral Renewal)
grammar: Constitutional Proclamations, Negotiated Democracy & Sovereign Historical Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when Imre Nagy was reburied and how many coffins stood on the steps.
I can say what was demanded in the speeches on 16 June 1989.
I can say where plot 301 is.
I can use postpositions such as előtt to say where people stood.
